✅ CellCog has completed chat "6afe0675b1050f6fc259e7be"

CellCog stops operating on a chat for one of three reasons:
  1. Task completed — the work you requested is done
  2. Clarifying questions — CellCog needs more information to proceed
  3. Roadblock — something prevented completion (e.g., insufficient credits)

Read the response below to determine which case applies.
If CellCog needs input, send a follow-up message to continue.
If the task is complete, no action needed.

── Response ──────────────────────────────────

<MESSAGE FROM openclaw on Chat 6afe0675b1050f6fc259e7be at 2026-11-18 20:11 UTC>
Create ONE game-ready 3D character model (GLB) from this concept art reference:
<SHOW_FILE>C:\Users\lenovo\Desktop\gaziantep\antep\docs\ref\K01_yasli_esnaf.png</SHOW_FILE>

Character: Elderly shopkeeper, about 65, white beard, red fez, long worn brown coat, striped waist sash, dark baggy shalwar trousers, leather shoes
Setting: Gaziantep (Aintab), Ottoman Empire, 1918-1921. Keep the clothing, colours, proportions and age exactly as in the reference;
do not modernise or stylise. Realistic, not cartoon.

Requirements:
- Full body, single character, neutral A-pose (arms slightly away from the body, legs slightly apart) so it can be rigged later.
- Neutral facial expression, mouth closed. No props in the hands, no base or pedestal.
- Around 20,000-30,000 triangles, PBR materials (base colour, normal, roughness), textures embedded in the GLB.
- Real-world scale: about 1.68 m tall, feet on the ground plane at the origin, facing +Z.
Deliver the GLB file and one preview image. Save outputs to: C:\Users\lenovo\Desktop\gaziantep\godot\modeller\karakter\K01_yasli_esnaf
<MESSAGE END>

<MESSAGE FROM cellcog on Chat 6afe0675b1050f6fc259e7be at 2026-11-18 20:24 UTC>
The game-ready model of K01 Yaşlı Esnaf is finished. It matches the reference: elderly shopkeeper, white beard, red fez, long worn brown coat, dark waistcoat, cream shirt, red striped sash, dark baggy şalvar trousers and worn leather shoes. It stands in a neutral A-pose with empty hands and no base.

**Files**

GLB model:
<SHOW_FILE>C:\Users\lenovo\Desktop\gaziantep\godot\modeller\karakter\K01_yasli_esnaf\K01_yasli_esnaf.glb</SHOW_FILE>

Preview image (front, three-quarter and back views of the final GLB):
<SHOW_FILE>C:\Users\lenovo\Desktop\gaziantep\godot\modeller\karakter\K01_yasli_esnaf\K01_yasli_esnaf_preview.png</SHOW_FILE>

**Technical specs (measured on the exported GLB)**

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Triangles | 25,000 (one mesh, one primitive) |
| Height | 1.680 m (Y from 0.0 to 1.68) |
| Origin | Centre of the feet, at the world origin; soles on the Y=0 plane |
| Facing | +Z (glTF is +Y up) |
| Bounds | X ±0.462 m (A-pose arm span), Z ±0.187 m |
| Node transform | Identity (all transforms applied) |
| Vertex attributes | POSITION, NORMAL, TANGENT, `TEXCOORD_0` |
| Material | One PBR metallic-roughness material, `K01_yasli_esnaf_mat` |
| Textures (embedded, 2048×2048) | Base colour (JPEG, sRGB); metallic-roughness (PNG); tangent-space normal map (PNG) |
| File size | About 8.6 MB |

**How it was made**
1. I generated a clean A-pose front reference from your concept art. Only the pose changed; face, outfit and colours stayed the same.
2. I generated a high-detail model from it (500k triangles, 8K textures).
3. I reduced it to 25k triangles, keeping the UVs.
4. I baked a normal map from the high-detail mesh onto the low-poly one so the fabric folds and fine detail are kept.
5. I scaled it to 1.68 m, placed it on the origin, exported it, and checked the result independently.

**Notes for the next step**
- The model is not rigged and has no skeleton. Its pose and spacing are ready for auto-rigging, e.g. Mixamo, AccuRig, or Rigify in Blender.
- The model's material settings mark it as fully metallic, but the metallic texture is close to 0 everywhere. In practice the surface renders as non-metallic cloth and leather, which is correct.
- The beard and fez are part of the single body mesh, not separate objects. The long coat flaps are part of the same mesh too, so expect to tune skin weights around the coat skirt when rigging.
<MESSAGE END>
